statement: Query the active Revit project and every open document with its title, path, units and version.
superiority: Dino 8 holds the project natively so no bridge session and no document-switch ambiguity exist.

acceptance.corpus: Two open documents with different units
acceptance.tolerance: Reported units, path and version equal the file metadata for both

statement: Save a document and manage worksets, including creating, activating and listing them.
superiority: Dino 8 saves with versioned snapshots and shows workset ownership live.

acceptance.tolerance: Created workset appears; saved file reopens with identical workset list

statement: Select model elements by category, class, family, type or level into the definition.
superiority: Dino 8 indexes the model so queries return instantly on very large projects.

acceptance.tolerance: Returned set equals independent filter count; under 300 ms

statement: Build element filters from parameter rules, logical and/or, bounding box, intersection and view-visibility conditions.
superiority: Dino 8 shows the match count live for every rule.

acceptance.tolerance: Match sets equal reference set operations exactly

statement: Read the values of built-in, shared, project and global parameters of elements with units.
superiority: Dino 8 returns typed values with units and storage type for every parameter.

acceptance.tolerance: All values equal source; unit conversions within 1e-9 relative

statement: Write parameter values to elements in one undoable transaction, with type and read-only checks.
superiority: Dino 8 validates and previews writes and rolls back atomically on failure.

acceptance.corpus: 1000 elements with writes including 20 read-only parameters
acceptance.tolerance: Writable values updated; read-only reported; one undo reverts all

statement: Define project, shared or global parameters with formulas and bind them to categories.

source.ref: Add Parameter / Define Parameter / Global Parameter

superiority: Dino 8 defines parameters from a schema table and reports binding conflicts upfront.

acceptance.tolerance: Parameters appear with the chosen groups and datatypes; formula evaluates to expected value

statement: Extract element geometry, bounding geometry and material-layer parts as Brep or mesh with detail level.
superiority: Dino 8 returns exact solids with persistent identity back to elements.

acceptance.corpus: Wall with 3 layers, floor, and door
acceptance.tolerance: Volume of extracted solids equals reported element volume within 0.1 percent

statement: Create walls from curves or profiles with type, level, height, location line and structural usage.
superiority: Dino 8 updates existing walls in place on re-evaluation and joins automatically.

acceptance.corpus: 20 walls from a curve set on two levels
acceptance.tolerance: Wall length and height equal inputs within 1 mm; joins resolved at corners

statement: Create floors, ceilings, roofs, columns and railings from boundary curves or points with type and level.

source.ref: Add Floor, Ceiling, Roof, Column, Railing

superiority: Dino 8 creates with slope and openings and keeps the link to the driving geometry.

acceptance.corpus: Floor from a polygon with a hole and a sloped roof
acceptance.tolerance: Area equals input area within 1e-4 relative; slope within 0.01 degrees

statement: Create structural framing from curves with section type, level and joins.

source.ref: Add Structural Beam, Column, Brace, Truss

superiority: Dino 8 maps frames to the analysis model one-to-one with consistent sections.

acceptance.tolerance: Member lengths within 1 mm; section assignment correct

statement: Create isolated, wall and slab foundations and beam systems from geometry.
superiority: Dino 8 relates foundations to supported columns automatically.

acceptance.corpus: 10 isolated footings, a strip footing, a slab
acceptance.tolerance: Positions within 1 mm; extents equal input

statement: Create, query and cluster analytical members, panels and boundary conditions for structural analysis models.
superiority: Dino 8 shares one model between design and analysis with no sync step.

acceptance.tolerance: Analytical member count equals physical; boundary conditions at the right nodes

statement: Place family instances at points, along curves, on work planes or as adaptive components.

source.ref: Add Component (Location / Curve / Work Plane / Adaptive)

superiority: Dino 8 places and updates instances in place with real-time preview.

acceptance.corpus: 500 instances placed at points, 50 on curves
acceptance.tolerance: Insertion points within 1 mm; rotation within 0.01 degrees

statement: Create, load and save component families from Grasshopper geometry with forms, voids, curves and openings.
superiority: Dino 8 makes parametric families natively and live-updates instances.

acceptance.corpus: Family with a form, a void and a reference plane
acceptance.tolerance: Family loads and instance volume equals form minus void within 0.1 percent

statement: Create DirectShape elements from Breps, meshes, curves or points under a chosen category.

acceptance.tolerance: Volume and area within 0.1 percent of input; category correct
